parole.significato: A tree native to South Asia, Vachellia nilotica subsp. indica, formerly Acacia nilotica subsp. indica.
parole.testo: Borrowed both from French baboul and from Hindi बबूल (babūl, “babul tree”), probably ultimately from Sanskrit वव्वोल (vavvola, “acacia”).

parole.significato: A former monetary subdivision, equivalent to one hundredth of a Guinean syli.
parole.testo: Borrowed from French cauri, from Hindi कौड़ी (kauṛī). Doublet of cowrie.
